identificationModule.briefTitle: BCMA-Targeted CAR-T Cell Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma and Plasma Cell Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: BCMA-Targeted CAR-T Cell Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma and Plasma Cell Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single arm study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BCMA-targeted CAR-T cells therapy for patients with relapsed/refractory Multiple Myeloma.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: There are limited options for treatment of relapse/refractory Multiple Myeloma. BCMA is expressed on most Multiple Myeloma cells so it is an ideal target for CAR-T. In this study, investigators will evaluate the safety and efficacy of CAR-T targeting BCMA in patients with relapsed/refractory Multiple Myeloma. The primary goal is safety and efficiency assessment, including adverse events and disease status after treatment.

armGroups.label: BCMA CAR-T cells treat
armGroups.description: Patients will be be treated with BCMA CAR-T cells

primaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events that related to treatment
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events will be recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: The response rate of BCMA CAR-T treatment in patients with relapse/refractory Multiple Myeloma that treatment by BCMA CAR-T cells therapy
primaryOutcomes.description: The response rate of BCMA CAR-T treatment will be recorded and assessed according to the IMWG

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of BCMA CAR-T cells in bone marrow and peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow and peripheral blood) rate of BCMA CAR-T cells were determined by means of flow cytometry

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quantity of BCMA CAR copies in bone marrow and peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow and peripheral blood) quantity of BCMA CAR copies were determined by means of qPCR

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quantity of clonal plasma cells in bone marrow
secondaryOutcomes.description: In vivo (bone marrow) quantity of clonal plasma cells

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Duration of Response (DOR) of BCMA CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed multiple myeloma
secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR will be assessed from the first assessment of sCR/CR/VGPR/PR to the first assessment of recurrence or progression of the disease or death from any cause (censored)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progress-free survival(PFS) of BCMA CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed multiple myeloma
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS will be assessed from the first CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause or the first assessment of progression (censored)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall survival(OS) of BCMA CAR-T treatment in patients with refractory/relapsed multiple myeloma
secondaryOutcomes.description: OS will be assessed from the first CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause (censored)
